hook.say: Five questions about the world's islands. Three seconds each. Can you make it to the end?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is the largest island in the world?
questions.fact: About 80% of Greenland lies under a giant sheet of ice.
questions.sayAnswer: Greenland! About 80 percent of it lies under a giant sheet of ice.

questions.q: The island of Bali belongs to which country?
questions.fact: Bali is the only Hindu-majority province in Indonesia.
questions.sayAnswer: Indonesia! Bali is the only province in Indonesia with a Hindu majority.

questions.q: Which is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.fact: Sicily is also home to Etna, Europe's tallest active volcano.
questions.sayAnswer: Sicily! It is also home to Mount Etna, the tallest active volcano in Europe.

questions.fact: About 90% of Madagascar's wildlife lives nowhere else on Earth.
questions.sayAnswer: The Indian Ocean! About 90 percent of Madagascar's wildlife lives nowhere else on Earth.

questions.q: Which island is shared by three countries?
questions.fact: Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei share Borneo, the 3rd largest island.
questions.sayAnswer: Borneo! Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei share it. It is the 3rd largest island in the world.
